protocol.support: Each synthetic dataset is ONE pre-segmented patch over [-1,1]^2; independent queries over [-.65,.65]^2.
protocol.noise: Independent Gaussian displacement along clean surface normal. Same points and queries for every method.
protocol.normal_orientation: Unsigned normal angle; principal curvatures sign-aligned to truth solely for scoring.
protocol.geometry: Four Newton normal-projection steps then analytic gradient/Hessian/tangent 2x2 shape operator.
protocol.baseline: Local 64-NN and 256-NN PCA-frame degree-2 polynomial, batched normalized normal equations. Not CGAL binaries.
protocol.pca: Normal and slope only; surface variation is dimensionless and NOT compared to physical curvature.
protocol.taubin_general: Ablation planar_ratio=0, fitting=taubin; original pipeline and default thresholds unchanged.
protocol.speed: Warm cache; randomized interleaved order; construction included, destruction excluded; no disk I/O or segmentation.
protocol.real: Same pre-segmented supports for all methods; query ALL retained points. No real curvature ground truth.
protocol.limitations: No outliers, occlusion or segmentation errors in synthetic scenes; no claim of full odometry accuracy or segmentation robustness.

sources.title: Goldman (2005), Curvature formulas for implicit curves and surfaces
